name: com.hk.modtools.orphanfinder
displayName: HK Mod Tools - Orphan Resource Finder
description: Finds unreferenced ("orphaned") IMAGE assets in a Humankind mod's Resources folder so you can review and delete them, shrinking the published package. Auto-calibrates Amplitude's {a,b,c,d} GUID encoding each scan. Standalone (declares com.hk.modtools.shared only to join the shared Update Checker / Options ecosystem; uses none of its types).
